title: Mobs Drop Their Abilities
description: Defeat mobs and steal their powers! Unlock unique passive abilities like flight and teleportation, or use active items like the explosive Detonator. Transform your survival experience by using the monsters' own strengths against them.
body:
## The Concept

This mod rewards you for hunting monsters. When you defeat certain mobs, you take their powers. You can unlock inherent body passives or get powerful active weapons to use in survival. 

## Inherent Abilities (Body Passives)

These powers become a permanent part of your character once you defeat the mob:

* **Iron Golem:** Gives you 20 extra hearts of health.
* **Chicken:** Grants permanent slow falling.
* **Bees:** Automatically applies Thorns III to any armor you put on.
* **Horse:** Boosts your jumping and sprinting speed.
* **Squid:** Lets you breathe underwater.
* **Enderman:** Unlocks the ability to teleport.
* **Wither:** Gives you constant self healing.
* **Bat:** Grants permanent night vision.

## Physical Weapons & Items

These mobs drop physical, overpowered gear that you can hold and use:

* **Warden:** Drops a gun that shoots sonic booms.
* **Ghast:** Drops a bazooka that fires fire charges.
* **Blaze:** Drops a gun that shoots fire and an item that gives infinite blaze rods.
* **Ender Dragon:** Drops grenades that release dragon breath.
* **Skeleton:** Drops a maxed out bow with Power V, Unbreaking III, Flame, and Infinity.
* **Turtle:** Drops a powerful shield.
* **Spider:** Drops useable cobwebs.

## Important Notes For Players

Please read these two rules before playing to avoid losing your items.

1. **Inventory Space:** Always keep 2 to 3 slots empty in your inventory at all times. You need this free space to correctly receive the OP weapons from the mobs.
2. **Explosion Danger:** Do not use or experiment with TNT, detonators, or any other explosives near fallen weapons. When the weapons are on the ground in their bouncing collectable state, an explosion will completely destroy the item before you can pick it up.

## Getting Started

Load the mod into your world, grab your sword, and start hunting. Try to collect all the abilities and weapons to become the most powerful player in the game.
